coverage.limitation: 65 pre-API source-first AI checklist items; variable granularity and not exhaustive; matching proportion is not formal recall

limitations: same assistant develops and reviews, unblinded single-AI audit; not independent expert truth
uniform up-to-60 sample of all candidate outputs; unknown quality outside sample
same build documents, possible neighboring previously-reviewed context; not independent document generalization
automatic structural/provenance pass does not prove complete semantics or conditions
relation dedup is exact canonical type/name/relation/polarity; context-qualified assertions remain distinct

target_75_percent.interpretation: A sample criterion, not certification that at least 75% of all outputs or future pages are usable

by_page.coverage_note: Scanned entire target page 108. Extracted knowledge from ASSEMBLING PUMP SET continuation (shaft seal step 3 and three NOTE blocks regarding tool protection, silicone grease application, slide ring/carbon ring fitting, settling time, and post-start leak check via leak hole). Extracted section 10.3.5 Fitting impeller Ø215/265 procedure (sunk key, impeller positioning, securing with washers 7/8 and nut). Footer contact info ignored. Fastening relationships (washer/nut to impeller) could not be precisely represented due to schema limitations and are marked unresolved. Previous page context (10.3.4 Fitting shaft seal steps 1-2) used only to confirm procedural continuity for step 3.

Scanned sections 10 (Inspection and Maintenance), 10.1 (Draining the Pump), 10.2 (Bearings) including all grease brand recommendations (ESSO Beacon 2, BP Energrease EP 2, Shell Alvania grease 2, Mobil lux grease EP 2, Castrol Spherol AP2, Texaco Multifak EP 2, Q8 Rembrandt EP 2 and Rubens, Statoil Uniway U2 recorded as examples under lithium-basis specification), and section 11 (Repairs - Ordering Spare Parts). Safety prerequisite about repairman familiarity with pumped liquid type (b0003-b0004) is personnel safety guidance not representable as pump-system knowledge. Footer contact information scanned and excluded as out of scope. Previous page fault table context not continued on this target page.

Scanned entire target page containing Model FS pump disassembly procedure steps 8B through 24B. Extracted all component removal actions, structural locations, retention requirements for reassembly (springs, impeller key, locking key, pin), prohibitions (no puller on grease retainer, no unnecessary wear ring removal), and operating conditions (interference fit). Previous page context (Model F steps 26A-29A) was acknowledged but not used as source for new records since the target page explicitly redirects Model F pumps away from these steps. All representable pump knowledge from this page has been captured.

Scanned sections 4.5 (Environmental Aspects), 5.1 (Product Features), 5.2 (Purpose), 5.3 (Application Scope), and 5.4 (Working Medium). Extracted environmental maintenance requirement, dismantling obligation, all operating condition limits (temperature, flow, pressure, pH, ambient temp, altitude), working medium constraints, and high-density/viscosity motor sizing rule. Section 5.1 product features (low noise, high efficiency, etc.) and 5.2 application purposes are general marketing/application descriptions without representable pump-system component, fault, or operational triples; left unrepresented. Footer contact info ignored.

Scanned section 4.1 Work range entirely. Extracted all operating conditions (media temperature limits by fluid/material/seal/bearing config, ambient temperature limits, density/viscosity limits), causal chains (high ambient/altitude→reduced motor cooling→adapted power; high density/viscosity→increased torque/power→shaft/motor overload), structural relations (ball bearing on pump shaft, pump casing/rear cover materials), material specifications (GGG40, 1.4436, Super Duplex, ductile iron), and prohibitions (avoid freezing). Negative polarity used for 'Avoid freezing'. Footer contact info excluded as out of scope. No troubleshooting tables on this page.

Scanned entire target page 6 (SAFETY PAGE A-3) of OM-04760. Extracted knowledge about: maximum continuous operating speed reference to performance curve; fuel hazards and required fuel line inspection/refueling precautions for internal combustion engines; engine exhaust chemical hazard warning; prohibition against tampering with engine governor and its role in establishing safe operating limits; requirement to install/operate per national/local/industry standards. All content is safety/regulatory warnings rather than detailed pump-component structural or diagnostic data. No tables present. Previous page context (page 5 SAFETY) was not continued as a single procedure but shares the same safety section theme; no cross-page triples were fabricated.

Scanned entire target page (Safety Section A). Extracted pump model variants and drive types, 7-step service preparation procedure (power disconnect, cooling, temperature check, valve closure, venting, draining), incompatible liquid prohibition with causal risk, lifting prerequisite (remove hoses/piping), installation connection inspection requirement, and closed-discharge-valve prohibition with component deterioration mechanism. No troubleshooting tables present. All safety/procedural content representable within allowed schema was captured; general manual responsibility statements and warranty references on previous page were out of scope for pump-system triples.
